title_zh: 語音信箱裡的明天留言
story_zh: 凌晨兩點，我收到一封語音留言。發送時間竟是明天晚上十點，寄件號碼是我自己。 留言說，九點十四分我會打破杯子；下午四點公司會停電；晚上十點，無論誰敲門都不要開。 我當它是惡作劇。但九點十四分，杯子滑落，正好碎在我腳邊，一秒都不差。 下午四點，辦公室燈光全滅。人群忙著找手電筒，只有我盯著手機，害怕最後一句。 我提早回家，把門上三道鎖扣好。九點五十九分，第二封來自明天的留言出現：「別相信第一個我。」 十點整，門外響起三下重敲。有人喊：「消防隊！這棟樓失火了！」門縫裡真的鑽進淡淡煙味。 第一則留言急喊「不要開！」第二則卻說：「你聽見的警報是真的。那個聲音，只想把你留在屋內。」 我扭開門鎖。門外空蕩蕩，地上只有一台正在播放救援喊聲的錄音機。它亮起錄音燈；手機顯示：留言正在寄給昨天。
story_en: At two in the morning, I received a voicemail timestamped tomorrow at ten p.m. The sender was my own phone number. The voice predicted a broken cup at nine fourteen, an office blackout at four, and one last rule: at ten tonight, do not open the door. I called it a prank. But at exactly nine fourteen, a cup slipped from my hand and shattered beside my feet. At four, the office lights died. Everyone searched for flashlights. I stared at my phone, terrified of the final prediction. I went home and locked the door. At nine fifty-nine, a second message arrived from tomorrow: Don’t trust the first version of me. At ten, three heavy knocks shook the door. “Fire department! The building is burning!” A thin ribbon of smoke slipped underneath. The first message screamed, “Don’t open!” The second whispered, “The fire is real. That voice only wants you trapped inside.” I opened the door. No firefighters. Just a recorder playing their voices. Its red light switched to RECORD. My phone said: SENDING THIS MESSAGE TO YESTERDAY.
